risk_note: B2-02z (D10-2092 ⑤ / D10-2093 / D10-2097 / D10-2084; notification, RV2 by the fund notice). Registers BALANCE_CORRECTED in admin-channels/catalog.ts (inbox only, default channel inbox, no SMS variables, same shape as BALANCE_ADJUSTED); renderBalanceCorrectedMessage is a pure function (default title 余额更正 and the D10-2092 body verbatim, amounts by @couli/money formatYuan unsigned: '-' before '¥', no '+', trailing zeros dropped, ¥0, no thousands separators; function replacers so '$&' in an override stays literal; equal before/after → null); recordBalanceCorrectedMessage writes on the caller's transaction: reads users.status (deleting / deleted / missing → no write), the app's notify_templates override, inserts notify_logs (inbox, success, dedupe_key balance_corrected:{reconDiffId}:{balanceVersion}) with ON CONFLICT (app_id, dedupe_key) DO NOTHING and only then inbox_messages. index.ts exports both; app.module.ts unchanged (no recalculation flow in ledger yet; the call comes with B2-02x). Test machine: test/spec/notification 101 files 944 tests green (rule tests included), verify:fast green.

reviews.note: Fresh independent Claude via claude-run.sh; pass with no findings, validate ok, positions unchanged (couli-runs/B2-02z/review-money-r1.json). Asked to judge the unlocked users.status read: a switch to deleting committed after the read equals sending before the change, not an illegal state.

longrun.note: property tests use propParams(); the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
